text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific treatment in the event of overdose of JUXTAPID. In the event of overdose, the patient should be treated symptomatically, and supportive measures instituted as required. Liver-related tests should be monitored. Hemodialysis is unlikely to be beneficial given that lomitapide is highly protein-bound.
